transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We've got three mandatory training sessions to get done in the next three workdays: forklift-operator certification, generator-operator refresher, and hazardous-materials handling refresher. Each one needs a two-hour block. Before I sign off on the schedule, I need updates from each of you. Training NCO, what's the status on the forklift certification course and any requirements you have? Motor pool sergeant, what do you need for the generator refresher? Safety officer, what's the situation with the hazmat refresher? Let's hear what you've got so we can get this scheduled properly.
